events.message: Operator set FV-001 to Manual to 100.0%
Alarm Active: LAL: Low Liquid Level Pre-Alarm (< 1200 mm)
ESD Trip Triggered! Causes: LALL <= 770 mm: Liquid SDV (UZV-002) Tripped, Note 26 Interlock: ZSC-002 closed -> Gas SDV (UZV-003) Tripped (Gas Blow-by Prevention)
Mission Failed: LALL Trip Failure: Level dropped to 770 mm, triggering Note 26 emergency gas isolation.

debrief.physical_cause_en: Because free-surface chord width W(h) shrinks at bottom, dh/dt increases for identical volumetric outflow.
debrief.design_lesson_en: Dropping below 770 mm immediately activates Note 26 emergency gas isolation.

educational_review.learning_objective: Practice manual valve throttling and understand how cylindrical geometry causes level rate-of-fall to accelerate near the bottom.
